name: Urushihara Kenzaburou
source:
Kenzaburou is a gentlemanly [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parakeet]parakeet[/URL] who owns Torimi Café. He has a calm and humble personality and is quite a neat bird. Depending on certain choices, Hiyoko has the option of working for him. He appears in the summer side story.

NOTE: Kenzaburou is a full version only character.

[Based on his [URL=http://hatoful.wikia.com/wiki/Kenzaburou_Urushihara]Hatoful Boyfriend Wikia[/URL] entry.]
